problem: A healthy Bedrijfsgeheugen LinkedIn organization connection was rejected because LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO returned organization id 18234216 while the publisher compared only against the full URN urn:li:organization:18234216.
root_cause: The company capability selector assumed the provider would serialize organization identity only as a full URN string. Numeric JSON organization ids were not normalized before comparison.
fix: Normalize the canonical organization URN to its id component and accept either the full URN or canonical numeric id in organization capability evidence before rejecting a connection.
prevention: Treat LinkedIn organization URN and numeric organization id as equivalent identity representations.
Do not confuse missing optional readback scope with missing organization write capability.
Resume the existing daily publication claim after auth recovery; never create a replacement side effect.
